data.long_meaning: Ginelle is a French name derived from the word ginestre, meaning 'juniper'. In medieval France, juniper was associated with the Virgin Mary and was believed to protect against evil. The name Ginelle thus carries the spiritual significance of a precious and protected child of God. The name Ginelle carries the meaning “Jewel, Treasured One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ginelle usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, treasured one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ginelle total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
data.cultural_impact: Historically in medieval France, the name Ginelle was popular specifically due to the association of juniper with the Virgin Mary. It was believed that this fragrant plant protected against evil forces and offered a sacred space, making it an ideal name for a child.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ginelle radiates a sense of protection and safety, as it is derived from the name ginestre, which was used to honor the Virgin Mary and her divine protection in medieval France. It signifies the child as a precious and cherished gift from God, deserving of love, care, and spiritual guidance.
